Definition: , and ταύτας dative case and accusative case feminine plural respectively of G3778; (to or with or by, etc.) these:--hence, that, then, these, those.
BiblicalUsage: The word is these, the feminine plural of this, to or with or by these. Jesus says on these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets; after those days Elisabeth conceived and hid herself five months; and He says ye shall be baptized with the Holy Ghost not many days hence.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that these always points back to something said before, and the commandments, the days, and the promise all hang together.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
